name: Solar-UniBench
description: Initial public open-source release of Solar-UniBench v1.0 for ESSD manuscript submission. Full Standardization Curation Pipeline: Universal data harmonization from heterogeneous raw archives to unified Parquet/Zarr contract formats. Sample Dataset Integration: Includes a lightweight 1-day Folsom multimodal dataset for 1-minute quickstart verification. Comprehensive Benchmark Suite: Baseline models, ML, Deep Learning algorithms, and autonomous agentic workflow capabilities. Publication Figures Generator: Standardized figure generation suite producing paper figures (Fig 1 – Fig 10).
